name: Nous Portal
short: Nous Research's Hermes Agent platform: 200+ models from frontier labs behind a single API key (plus a hosted Tool Gateway and agent cloud hosting), with a free tier limited to free models and paid subscriptions that include Hermes usage and cloud-agent hosting; API keys always bill pay-as-you-go credits. ChatGPT plan sharing available.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free models only, standard rate limits, $0 monthly credits. ChatGPT plan sharing: connect an eligible ChatGPT account for supported inference with no paid Nous subscription (tools and Hermes Cloud hosting bill separately to credits).

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Hermes Agent usage included within daily/weekly/monthly limits; one cloud agent with up to 4 GB RAM / 25 GB disk included; any model usable (pricier models consume included usage faster); hosted tools bill to the same credit balance. API keys always use pay-as-you-go credits.

plans.name: Super
plans.notes: Hermes Agent usage included within daily/weekly/monthly limits; one cloud agent with up to 4 GB RAM / 100 GB disk included; API keys always use pay-as-you-go credits.

plans.name: Ultra
plans.notes: Hermes Agent usage included within daily/weekly/monthly limits; one cloud agent with up to 8 GB RAM / 100 GB disk included; API keys always use pay-as-you-go credits.

plans.name: Credit top-up
plans.notes: Prepaid credit top-ups billed through Stripe.
